verdict.rationale: Omnara exposes a REST API, CLI, and TypeScript SDK for programmatically launching agents, plus webhooks for events (omnara-docs-2, omnara-docs-14, omnara-docs-22), which are the building blocks one could wire into a CI/CD pipeline to trigger an agent. However, there is no documented CI/CD integration (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins plugin, build-failure hook) or example of automatically detecting a failing build/test and dispatching an agent to fix it. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs, a build/test-failure triggered workflow example, and any first-party GitHub Actions or similar CI connector.
